$comment: PR-27. Everything outside the repository the method needs for the Tower: GitHub secrets and variables, and the app's Vercel environment. scripts/devos/setup-check.mjs checks NAMES only (never values) and keeps the 'Dev OS: setup needed' issue up to date. Same format as the pilot's devos/setup.json; items for inactive modules (r2, firebase) and the Vercel bypass are absent on purpose (Tower ADR-004). when: always | module:<name> | var:<NAME> | method. blocks: cycle | deploy | none.

items.title: Cursor key for the builder (one or two accounts)
steps: cursor.com → Dashboard → Integrations → API Keys → create a key named devos-tower.
GitHub → this repository → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret `CURSOR_API_KEY`.
Optional second account (PR-29): `CURSOR_API_KEY_2`.

items.title: Claude credential for the reviewer (one or two accounts)
steps: On your computer run `claude setup-token` and sign in with your Claude plan.
Add the token as the repository secret `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` (or an API key as `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`).
Optional second account (PR-29): `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_2` (or `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_2`).

items.title: Runner token that may change workflows (method fixes) — a separate token for this repository
steps: GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained → Generate a NEW token (never reuse the pilot's).

Repository access: only devos-control-tower. Permissions (Read and write): Contents, Pull requests, Workflows, Issues, Actions, Commit statuses. Expiry ≤ 90 days. Once set, the runner uses it for every gh call (dispatch, comments, statuses, merges), not only for workflow pushes.
Add it as the repository secret `DEVOS_PAT`. Needed only when a method fix (TM01) changes a workflow file.

items.title: Vercel deploy access (private project, Standard Deployment Protection)
steps: vercel.com → create the project `devos-control-tower` from this repository; Settings → Deployment Protection = Standard (verify by name in T01's review).
Account Settings → Tokens → create `devos-tower` (scope: your team). Project → Settings → General: copy the Project ID; team Settings: copy the Team ID (`VERCEL_ORG_ID`).
Add the three as repository secrets. Do NOT create a Protection Bypass for Automation secret (Tower ADR-004).

items.title: Turn on the Vercel deploy step
steps: GitHub → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → Variables → New repository variable `DEVOS_VERCEL` = `true`.

items.title: Supabase production project (deploy: backup and migrations)
steps: Supabase → New project `devos-control-tower` (after the M0 capacity check: paid plan, second organisation or co-location — your choice). Authentication → Providers: GitHub ON with the Tower's GitHub OAuth app client id/secret; every other provider OFF; Email OFF.
Copy the project reference, set the database password, create an access token; choose a backup passphrase and keep a copy offline.
Add the four repository secrets.

items.title: Turn on the database step of the deploy
steps: Repository variable `DEVOS_SUPABASE` = `true`.

items.title: Supabase values the app reads (Vercel)
steps: Vercel → project → Settings → Environment Variables: the two NEXT_PUBLIC names for every environment; `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY` for **Production only**, marked Sensitive (service role; read only by server modules, guard:data rule 6).

items.title: The Tower's production URL (OIDC audience, host check)
steps: Vercel → Environment Variables → **Production**: `TOWER_URL` = `https://<the production hostname>` with no trailing slash. It is the OIDC audience every reporting project uses as `tower.url` (pilot ADR-005) and the host the machine routes accept (Tower ADR-004).
A custom domain later = a new audience: change it here and in every project's `tower.url` together.

items.title: GitHub App `devos-control-tower` webhook secret
steps: GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → GitHub Apps → New: name `devos-control-tower`; Webhook URL `<TOWER_URL>/api/github/webhook`; generate a secret; permissions READ: Actions, Checks, Commit statuses, Pull requests, Metadata; events: workflow_run, check_run, status, pull_request, installation, installation_repositories (Tower ADR-003). Install it on devos-pilot and devos-control-tower only.
Vercel → Environment Variables → **Production**: `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, Sensitive. Needed from T03.

items.title: The GitHub App exists and is installed
steps: Repository variable `DEVOS_GITHUB_APP` = `true` once the App is installed on the pilot and the Tower (T03 reads it as a precondition by name).
